title: Keyturn Trip Booking Billing Schedule: Date Changes, Retries, Refund Timing and Pass-Through Fees
content:
The figures that govern the money side of a Keyturn Trip Booking once it is confirmed — changing its dates, re-presenting a declined charge, returning money to the guest, and passing on a toll or a citation — are carried by its rate plan and are set out here for all six.

| Figure | Hourly | Daily | Weekend | Weekly | Monthly | Extended Stay |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Fee for a date change once the free changes are used (USD) | 0.00 | 25.00 | 25.00 | 35.00 | 45.00 | 55.00 |
| Free date changes on one reservation | 2 | 1 | 1 | 1 | 2 | 2 |
| Late payment fee (USD) | 15.00 | 20.00 | 20.00 | 25.00 | 30.00 | 35.00 |
| Times a failed charge is re-presented | 3 | 3 | 3 | 4 | 4 | 5 |
| Hours between two attempts | 12 | 24 | 24 | 24 | 48 | 48 |
| Business days a refund takes to reach the card | 5 | 7 | 7 | 7 | 10 | 12 |
| Toll administration fee (USD) | 4.95 | 5.95 | 5.95 | 6.95 | 7.95 | 8.95 |
| Citation administration fee (USD) | 35.00 | 45.00 | 45.00 | 55.00 | 65.00 | 75.00 |

### Notes on the columns

The date-change fee stands at 0.00 USD on the Keyturn Hourly Rate Plan, which publishes no such fee, and rises to 55.00 USD at the top of the ladder. The free date changes figure does not grade with the plan: it is 2 on the Keyturn Hourly Rate Plan, 1 on the Keyturn Daily, Weekend and Weekly Rate Plans, and 2 again on the Keyturn Monthly and Extended Stay Rate Plans.

The retry figures pair a count with an interval in hours: 3 attempts spaced 12 hours apart on the Keyturn Hourly Rate Plan, 3 spaced 24 on the Keyturn Daily and Weekend Rate Plans, 4 spaced 24 on the Keyturn Weekly Rate Plan, 4 spaced 48 on the Keyturn Monthly Rate Plan and 5 spaced 48 on the Keyturn Extended Stay Rate Plan. Refund timing is stated in business days and the two administration fees in dollars.
